newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner unit wins NOK 400 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner unit wins NOK 400 mln deal.

text.p: Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Monday its Singapore construction subsidiary Gammon Pte Ltd had been awarded a 400 million crown contract for a residential development.
The contract was awarded by Cycle and Carriage Properties (Hillview) Pte Ltd, Kvaerner said in a statement.
The development, to be built in the Upper Timah area on a 23,000 square metre site, will consist of four 10-storey blocks with basement car parking.
The contract is the second that Gammon has won from Cycle and Carriage. In 1996, Gammon was awarded a $14.7 million deal for a 10-storey appartment block.
